title: Recent Immigration Law Changes
content: A summary of the recent changes in immigration law includes the expansion of visa quotas for skilled workers and the introduction of a new temporary protection status for individuals from countries experiencing political turmoil. It is important for community members to consult with a legal advisor to understand how these changes may apply to their individual circumstances.
